profile.name: linux-x64-release-static
profile.args_gn:
target_os = "linux"
target_cpu = "x64"
is_debug = false
is_component_build = false
use_sysroot = true

scope: Evaluated GN target closure and typed file/include references for this profile; not a C++ include closure or a successful build
dependency_policy: The pinned Chromium root DEPS and Gitlinks are authoritative for this integrated graph; do not independently sync child DEPS with standalone defaults.

objects.condition: ((checkout_linux or checkout_mac or checkout_ios or checkout_android) and host_os == "linux") and non_git_source
(checkout_linux or checkout_mac or checkout_android) and host_os == "win"

selected_objects.condition: ((checkout_linux or checkout_mac or checkout_ios or checkout_android) and host_os == "linux") and non_git_source

limitations: Only Linux x64 in this configuration is resolved.
Most non-Blink C++ source bodies are not materialized; original pinned repositories remain required.
Host Python is recorded rather than installed from the original hermetic package.
Packages retain DEPS platform conditions; use these when fetching.
Graph generation is not compilation, linking or runtime validation.
package_resolution: CIPD ObjectRef content hashes; GCS generation, size and SHA256 retained for selected Linux objects
